description: Documentation source file describing the C API for CVXOPT, including matrix structures, creation functions, and usage examples for dense and sparse matrices.

methods.name: Matrix_New
methods.description: Creates a new uninitialized dense matrix of specified size and type.

methods.name: Matrix_NewFromMatrix
methods.description: Returns a copy of a given matrix converted to a specified type.

methods.name: Matrix_NewFromSequence
methods.description: Creates a matrix from a Python sequence with specified type.

methods.name: uniform
methods.description: Generates a dense matrix with uniformly distributed random values.

methods.name: SpMatrix_New
methods.description: Creates a new sparse zero matrix with specified dimensions and maximum non-zero elements.

methods.name: SpMatrix_NewFromMatrix
methods.description: Returns a copy of a sparse matrix.

methods.name: SpMatrix_NewFromIJV
methods.description: Creates a sparse matrix from triplet (I, J, V) description.
